PlutoVG 1.3.3, the rasterizer behind layerExDraw.dll (layerexdraw/).

  source:  https://github.com/sammycage/plutovg
           via ref/krkr-ns/krkrsdl2/external/plutovg (KRKR-ns vendored copy)
  commit:  f63f9b5 (upstream has no tagged releases; the commit is the pin)
  license: LICENSE (MIT, PlutoVG itself); source/FTL.TXT (FreeType License,
           for the rasterizer and stroker it embeds, prefixed PVG_FT_)

Local changes: none in this tree. include/ and source/ are copied unchanged from
the KRKR-ns tree, which carries one patch of its own (source/plutovg-font.c,
__SWITCH__ guards that read font files into memory instead of mmap, for libnx).
It is compiled out on Linux and kept as is.

Build: the .c files are compiled by modules/layerexdraw/CMakeLists.txt into the
engine executable with PLUTOVG_BUILD_STATIC. include/ is a private include
directory of the layerexdraw module (plutovg.h is used as <plutovg.h>).
